在文件 alpha-app-policy.yaml 中为带标签 app=alpha-app 的 Pod 创建 NetworkPolicy。该策略允许发往带标签 team=beta 的命名空间中 Pod 的出站流量；除了由 53 端口表示的 DNS 之外，拒绝其他所有出站流量：

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: alpha-app-policy
  namespace: team-alpha
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: alpha-app
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          team: beta
  - to:
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 53
— PDF p.367 —

The NetworkPolicy defined in the file beta-app-policy.yaml looks a little simpler. It allows the beta-app Pod to receive traffic from the team-alpha namespace on port 80:

文件 beta-app-policy.yaml 中定义的 NetworkPolicy 稍简单一些。它允许 beta-app Pod 在 80 端口接收来自 team-alpha 命名空间的流量：

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: beta-app-policy
  namespace: team-beta
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: beta-app
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          team: alpha
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80

Create both NetworkPolicy objects:

创建两个 NetworkPolicy 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f alpha-app-policy.yaml
$ kubectl apply -f beta-app-policy.yaml

Use the curl command to test the alpha-app Pod to make a call to the beta-app Service in the team-beta namespace. The command should succeed:

用 curl 从 alpha-app Pod 调用 team-beta 命名空间中的 beta-app Service。该命令应当成功：

$ kubectl exec -it alpha-app -n team-alpha -- \
  curl -v --connect-timeout 2 \
  http://beta-app.team-beta.svc.cluster.local:8080

Use the curl command to test the alpha-app Pod to an address on the internet. The command should fail:

用 curl 从 alpha-app Pod 访问一个互联网地址。该命令应当失败：

$ kubectl exec -it alpha-app -n team-alpha -- \
  curl -v --connect-timeout 2 http://google.com
— PDF p.368 —

Use the curl command to test the connectivity to the beta-app Service from a temporary Pod in the same namespace. The command should fail:

用 curl 从同一命名空间中的临时 Pod 测试到 beta-app Service 的连通性。该命令应当失败：

$ kubectl run test-pod --image=alpine/curl:8.14.1 -n team-beta --rm -it \
  --restart=Never -- curl -v --connect-timeout 2 http://beta-app:8080

Question 2第 2 题

Network policies are additive, which means you can apply them in any order. To make the changes more understandable, you may want to start with the deny policy first. The file default-deny-all.yaml shows the contents of the NetworkPolicy that denies all ingress communication within the production namespace:

NetworkPolicy 是叠加生效的，意味着可以按任意顺序应用。为了让改动更易理解，可以先从拒绝策略开始。文件 default-deny-all.yaml 展示了在 production 命名空间内拒绝所有入站通信的 NetworkPolicy 内容：

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress

Create the NetworkPolicy for the database component in the file database-policy.yaml. The NetworkPolicy applies to the Pods with the label assignment tier=database and only allows ingress traffic from Pods with the label assignment tier=backend on port 6379:

在文件 database-policy.yaml 中为数据库组件创建 NetworkPolicy。该策略作用于带标签 tier=database 的 Pod，只允许带标签 tier=backend 的 Pod 在 6379 端口的入站流量：

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: database-policy
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: database
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: backend
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6379

Create the NetworkPolicy for the backend component in the file backend-policy.yaml. This policy applies to Pods with the label assignment tier=backend. It allows incoming traffic from the frontend microservice and outgoing traffic to the database microservice:

在文件 backend-policy.yaml 中为后端组件创建 NetworkPolicy。该策略作用于带标签 tier=backend 的 Pod，允许来自前端微服务的入站流量，以及发往数据库微服务的出站流量：

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: backend-policy
  namespace: production
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tier: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: frontend
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          tier: database
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6379
  - to:
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 53
— PDF p.369 —

Create all NetworkPolicy objects:

创建所有 NetworkPolicy 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f default-deny-all.yaml
$ kubectl apply -f database-policy.yaml
$ kubectl apply -f backend-policy.yaml

Use the curl command from the frontend Pod to test connectivity to the database Pod. We are using the telnet protocol here to ensure it can connect to the database port. The command should fail:

从前端 Pod 用 curl 测试到数据库 Pod 的连通性。这里使用 telnet 协议来确认能否连上数据库端口。该命令应当失败：

$ kubectl exec -it frontend -n production -- curl -v --connect-timeout 2 \
  telnet://database:3306

Use the curl command from the frontend Pod to test connectivity to the backend Pod. The command should succeed:

从前端 Pod 用 curl 测试到后端 Pod 的连通性。该命令应当成功：

$ kubectl exec -it frontend -n production -- curl -v --connect-timeout 2 \
  http://backend:80
— PDF p.370 —

Use the curl command from the backend Pod to test connectivity to the database Pod. The command should succeed. Similar to the first command, we are using the telnet protocol:

从后端 Pod 用 curl 测试到数据库 Pod 的连通性。该命令应当成功。与第一条命令类似，这里也使用 telnet 协议：

$ kubectl exec -it backend -n production -- curl -v --connect-timeout 2 \
  telnet://database:3306

Chapter 21 Review Questions第 21 章复习题答案

Question 1第 1 题

First, create the Pod using the given YAML content:

先用给定的 YAML 内容创建 Pod：

$ kubectl apply -f setup.yaml
pod/date-recorder created

Inspecting the Pod's status exposes no obvious issues. The status is Running:

查看 Pod 状态看不出明显问题。状态为 Running：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME            READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
date-recorder   1/1     Running   0          5s

Render the logs of the container. The returned error message indicates that the file or directory /root/tmp/startup-marker.txt does not exist:

查看容器日志。返回的错误信息表明文件或目录 /root/tmp/startup-marker.txt 不存在：

$ kubectl logs date-recorder
[Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/root/tmp/startup-marker.txt'] {
  errno: -2,
  code: 'ENOENT',
  syscall: 'open',
  path: '/root/tmp/curr-date.txt'
}

We could try to open a shell to the container; however, the container image does not provide a shell:

我们可以尝试打开到容器的 shell，但该容器镜像没有提供 shell：

$ kubectl exec -it date-recorder -- /bin/sh
OCI runtime exec failed: exec failed: unable to start container process: exec: "/bin/sh": stat /bin/sh: no such file or directory: unknown
command terminated with exit code 126

We can use the debug command to create a debugging container for troubleshooting. The --share-processes flag lets us share the running nodejs process:

可以用 debug 命令创建一个调试容器来排障。--share-processes 标志让我们共享正在运行的 nodejs 进程：

$ kubectl debug -it date-recorder --image=busybox --target=debian \
  --share-processes
Targeting container "debian". If you don't see processes from this container it may be because the container runtime doesn't support this feature.
Defaulting debug container name to debugger-rns89.
If you don't see a command prompt, try pressing enter.
/ # ps
— PDF p.371 —
  PID   USER     TIME  COMMAND
      1 root      4:21 /nodejs/bin/node -e const fs = require('fs'); let timestamp = Date.now(); fs.writeFile('/root/tmp/startup-m...
     35 root      0:00 sh
     41 root      0:00 ps

Apparently, the directory we want to write to does indeed not exist:

显然，我们想写入的目录确实不存在：

$ kubectl exec failing-pod -it -- /bin/sh
/ # ls /root/tmp
ls: /root/tmp: No such file or directory

We'll likely want to change the command running the original container to point to the directory that does exist upon container start. Alternatively, it may make sense to mount an ephemeral volume to provide the directory, as shown here:

我们很可能需要修改原容器运行的命令，让它指向容器启动时确实存在的目录。另一种做法是挂载一个临时 volume 来提供该目录，如下所示：

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: date-recorder
spec:
  containers:
  - name: debian
    image: gcr.io/distroless/nodejs20-debian11
    command: ["/nodejs/bin/node", "-e", "const fs = require('fs'); let timestamp = Date.now(); fs.writeFile('/var/startup/startup-marker.txt', timestamp.toString(), err => { if (err) { console.error(err); } while(true) {} });"]
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /var/startup
      name: init-volume
  volumes:
  - name: init-volume
    emptyDir: {}

Question 2第 2 题

Create the objects from the setup.yaml file. You will see from the output that at least three objects have been created: a namespace, a Deployment, and a Service:

用文件 setup.yaml 创建对象。从输出可以看到至少创建了三个对象：一个命名空间、一个 Deployment 和一个 Service：

$ kubectl apply -f setup.yaml
namespace/y72 created
deployment.apps/web-app created
service/web-app created

You can list all objects relevant to the scenario using the following command:

用下面的命令可以列出与本场景相关的所有对象：

$ kubectl get all -n y72
NAME                           READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/web-app-5f77f59c78-8svdm   1/1     Running   0          10m
pod/web-app-5f77f59c78-mhvjz   1/1     Running   0          10m

NAME              TYPE        CLUSTER-IP       EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)
service/web-app   ClusterIP   10.106.215.153   <none>        80/TCP

NAME                      READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
deployment.apps/web-app   2/2     2            2           10m
— PDF p.372 —
NAME                                 DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/web-app-5f77f59c78   2         2         2       10m

The Service is named web-app and is of type ClusterIP. You can access the Service only from within the cluster. Trying to connect to the Service by its DNS name from a temporary Pod in the same namespace won't be allowed:

该 Service 名为 web-app，类型为 ClusterIP。只能从集群内部访问它。从同一命名空间中的临时 Pod 用其 DNS 名尝试连接该 Service 会被拒绝：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox --restart=Never -it --rm -n y72 \
  -- wget web-app
Connecting to web-app (10.106.215.153:80)
wget: can't connect to remote host (10.106.215.153): Connection refused
pod "tmp" deleted
pod y72/tmp terminated (Error)

The endpoint for the Service web-app cannot be resolved, as shown by the following command:

如下列命令所示，Service web-app 的 endpoint 无法解析：

$ kubectl get endpoints -n y72
NAME      ENDPOINTS   AGE
web-app   <none>      15m

Describing the Service object provides you will additional information, e.g., the label selector and the target port:

describe 该 Service 对象会给出更多信息，例如标签选择器和目标端口：

$ kubectl describe service web-app -n y72
Name:              web-app
Namespace:         y72
Labels:            <none>
Annotations:       <none>
Selector:          run=myapp
Type:              ClusterIP
IP Family Policy:  SingleStack
IP Families:       IPv4
IP:                10.106.215.153
IPs:               10.106.215.153
Port:              <unset>  80/TCP
TargetPort:        3001/TCP
Endpoints:         <none>
Session Affinity:  None
Events:            <none>

Upon inspecting the Deployment, you will find that the Pod template uses the label assignment app=webapp. The container port is set to 3000. This information doesn't match the configuration of the Service. The endpoints of the web-app Service now point to the IP address and container port of the replicas controlled by the Deployment:

查看 Deployment 时会发现 Pod 模板使用的标签是 app=webapp，容器端口设为 3000。这些信息与 Service 的配置不匹配。修正后，web-app Service 的 endpoints 会指向 Deployment 所控制副本的 IP 地址和容器端口：

$ kubectl get endpoints -n y72
NAME      ENDPOINTS                         AGE
web-app   10.244.0.3:3000,10.244.0.4:3000   24m
— PDF p.373 —

Edit the live object of the Service. Change the label selector from run=myapp to app=webapp, and the target port from 3001 to 3000:

编辑 Service 的线上对象。把标签选择器从 run=myapp 改为 app=webapp，把目标端口从 3001 改为 3000：

$ kubectl edit service web-app -n y72
service/web-app edited

After changing the Service configuration, you will find that you can open a connection to the Pod running the application:

修改 Service 配置之后，你会发现可以连上运行应用的 Pod 了：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.36.1 --restart=Never -it --rm -n y72 \
  -- wget web-app
Connecting to web-app (10.106.215.153:80)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************| ...
'index.html' saved
pod "tmp" deleted

Question 3第 3 题

Create the namespace with:

用下面的命令创建命名空间：

$ kubectl create ns stress-test
namespace/stress-test created

Create all Pods by pointing the apply command to the current directory:

用 apply 命令指向当前目录创建所有 Pod：

$ kubectl apply -f ./
pod/stress-1 created
pod/stress-2 created
pod/stress-3 created

Retrieve the metrics for the Pods from the Metrics Server using the top command:

用 top 命令从 Metrics Server 获取这些 Pod 的指标：

$ kubectl top pods -n stress-test
NAME       CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)
stress-1   50m          77Mi
stress-2   74m          138Mi
stress-3   58m          94Mi

The Pod with the highest amount of memory consumption is the Pod named stress-2. The metrics will look different on your machine given that the amount of consumed memory is randomized by the command executed per container.

内存消耗最高的是名为 stress-2 的 Pod。由于每个容器执行的命令所消耗的内存是随机的，你机器上的指标会与此不同。

— PDF p.374 —

Chapter 22 Review Questions第 22 章复习题答案

Question 1第 1 题

List all nodes in the cluster. You will see that the node worker-2 shows the status NotReady,SchedulingDisabled:

列出集群中的所有节点。你会看到节点 worker-2 的状态为 NotReady,SchedulingDisabled：

$ kubectl get nodes
NAME            STATUS                        ROLES           AGE   VERSION
control-plane   Ready                         control-plane   23m   v1.33.2
worker-1        Ready                         <none>          23m   v1.33.2
worker-2        NotReady,SchedulingDisabled   <none>          23m   v1.33.2

Check why scheduling is disabled. The command renders a taint that indicates that workload cannot be scheduled on the node:

检查调度为何被禁用。命令会输出一个污点，表明工作负载不能被调度到该节点：

$ kubectl describe node worker-node-2 | grep -i taint

Check the node for any other conditions. You will see the message "Kubelet stopped posting node status":

检查节点的其他状况。你会看到信息“Kubelet stopped posting node status”：

$ kubectl describe node worker-node-2 | grep -A10 Conditions

Uncordon the node to allow scheduling on the node again:

取消节点封锁，再次允许在该节点上调度：

$ kubectl uncordon worker-node-2

Check if the kubelet is healthy on the worker node. SSH into the node and check kubelet status. You will see that the kubelet process is inactive:

检查工作节点上的 kubelet 是否健康。SSH 登录到该节点并查看 kubelet 状态。你会看到 kubelet 进程处于 inactive 状态：

$ ssh worker-node-2
$ sudo systemctl status kubelet

Restart the kubelet process and verify that it is running properly:

重启 kubelet 进程并确认它正常运行：

$ sudo systemctl restart kubelet
$ sudo systemctl status kubelet

Check the node status. All nodes should show Ready without SchedulingDisabled:

查看节点状态。所有节点都应显示 Ready，且不再有 SchedulingDisabled：

$ kubectl get nodes

Run a test Pod specifically on worker-node-2. Verify that the Pod is running on the correct node:

专门在 worker-node-2 上运行一个测试 Pod。确认 Pod 运行在正确的节点上：

$ kubectl run test-pod --image=nginx:1.29.1 --overrides='{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"kubernetes.io/hostname":"worker-node-2"}}}'
$ kubectl get pod test-pod -o wide

Question 2第 2 题

Create the Deployment with the parameters provided in the instructions:

用题目说明中给出的参数创建 Deployment：

$ kubectl create deployment test-app --image=nginx:1.29.1 --replicas=3

Check the status of the Pods controlled by the ReplicaSet. All Pods will have the status Pending:

查看该 ReplicaSet 控制的 Pod 状态。所有 Pod 的状态都是 Pending：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-h2x4m   0/1     Pending   0          2m
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-k9p3n   0/1     Pending   0          2m
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-x7v2q   0/1     Pending   0          2m

Check why Pods are pending. Describe a pending Pod to see its events. The output indicates no scheduler found:

检查 Pod 为何处于 pending。describe 一个 pending Pod 查看其事件。输出表明找不到调度器：

$ kubectl describe pod test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-h2x4m | tail -10
— PDF p.375 —

Check the Pods in the kube-system namespace. The scheduler is in ImagePullBackOff state:

查看 kube-system 命名空间中的 Pod。调度器处于 ImagePullBackOff 状态：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep -E "scheduler|controller|apiserver|etcd"

Investigate the scheduler Pod. The scheduler is trying to use a nonexistent image version:

排查调度器 Pod。调度器正在尝试使用一个不存在的镜像版本：

$ kubectl describe pod kube-scheduler-master-node -n kube-system \
  | grep -A5 Events

Fix the scheduler manifest. SSH into the control plane node. Edit the scheduler configuration manifest. Fix the scheduler manifest by changing the image tag to the version of control plane node, e.g., v1.33.2:

修复调度器清单。SSH 登录到控制平面节点，编辑调度器配置清单。把镜像 tag 改成控制平面节点的版本（例如 v1.33.2）来修复调度器清单：

$ ssh control-plane
$ sudo vi /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml

Wait a moment for the kubelet to detect the change and restart the scheduler Pod. Once the scheduler Pod transitions back to normal operations, you can check for the test-app Pods again:

稍等片刻，让 kubelet 检测到改动并重启调度器 Pod。调度器 Pod 恢复正常运行后，就可以再次查看 test-app Pod：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-h2x4m   1/1     Running   0          8m
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-k9p3n   1/1     Running   0          8m
test-app-5d4d5b6c7b-x7v2q   1/1     Running   0          8m

All Pods should be back to the Running status.

所有 Pod 都应恢复到 Running 状态。

— PDF p.376 —
